content.short: Ridotto is the very first cross-chain gambling & lottery protocol.
content.description: Ridotto is the first cross-chain gambling and lottery protocol based on complete transparency, anonymity, security, and fairness. Our approach is to provide an open protocol, driven by the community, where users can play or build games and earn rewards by providing liquidity to the DeFi ecosystem. On top of the protocol, we developed the Ridotto platform. An easy-to-use and user-friendly app that offers a genuine and vibrant gambling experience. To provide full transparency, the Ridotto protocol runs over multiple smart contracts on decentralized blockchains.
content.meta: Find out about Ridotto (RDT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
